blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday gained an initial US$87 million commitment from China’s C&U Group on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) Economic Leaders’ Meeting here. The fund will develop a 20-hectare facility in Alitagtag, Batangas, set to become the largest production base outside China and the only manufacturing facility in Southeast Asia.
